facts.text: By default cloud migration removes all permission sets from existing online users except SUPER users.
Removed permissions are replaced with Intelligent Cloud permission set to prevent non-SUPER users from modifying data.
Sign in to Business Central online and open Cloud Migration Management page.
Select Show the rest, More options, Actions, then Enable/Disable Removing Permissions from Users.
Create custom per-tenant extension with OnBeforeResetUsersToIntelligentCloudPermissions event handler to keep permissions.
Users can keep original permissions to continue working during data replication or for service-to-service apps.
